LightningComponentBundle.description: Sidebar card showing active workflows (workouts, waivers, IC approvals, trades, reviews) on FI and DP record pages. Driven by Status_Indicator__mdt — add indicators via CMDT, no code change needed.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading text shown in the card header.

property.name: hideWhenEmpty
property.label: Hide card when no active indicators
property.description: When true, the entire card is removed from the sidebar when there are no active indicators. When false, an empty-state message is shown instead.
